protocol.title: deterministic dense replay of the seed1879 C2-to-C4 formation interval
protocol.status: exact training replay gated frozen causal localization
protocol.hypothesis: Exact replay will reproduce the original C4 endpoint and reveal one stable transition from unformed behavior to the L2-core/L3-support route within the saved C2-to-C4 interval.

endpoint_qualification_gate.model_state: exact canonical tensor fingerprint match to original C4
endpoint_qualification_gate.Probe_state: exact canonical tensor fingerprint match to original C4
endpoint_qualification_gate.optimizer_state: exact canonical recursive fingerprint match to original C4
endpoint_qualification_gate.CUDA_RNG: byte-exact match for every saved CUDA RNG state
endpoint_qualification_gate.validation_history: exact match for every original stage-2 validation record
endpoint_qualification_gate.stop_step: exactly 1000 with the original consecutive-pass termination
endpoint_qualification_gate.failure_action: classify replay_endpoint_mismatch_causal_panel_closed and do not open the causal panel

route_rules_inherited_from_Level_7_4.whole_memory_causal: formed behavior and reset-all, zero-all, and batch-roll-all query <=0.20
route_rules_inherited_from_Level_7_4.L2_core: whole-Memory causal; zero-L2 and roll-L2 <=0.20; keep-L2 >=0.80; zero-L3 >=0.80; keep-L3 <=0.20; keep-L2-L3 >=0.90
route_rules_inherited_from_Level_7_4.L3_support: keep-L2-L3 minus keep-L2 >=0.03 and intact minus roll-L3 >=0.05

registered_classification.exact_replay_and_single_stable_formation: endpoint gate passes; step0 is not L2-core/L3-support; target-route membership changes from false to true exactly once and remains true through step1000
registered_classification.exact_replay_with_route_regression_or_mu: endpoint gate passes but target-route membership becomes non-monotonic
registered_classification.exact_replay_without_registered_route_fo: endpoint gate passes but the registered target route is absent at step1000
registered_classification.replay_endpoint_mismatch_causal_panel_cl: one or more endpoint qualification components fail

secondary_outputs: last non-target to first stable-target step interval
L2 necessity, L3 support, and pair-recovery curves
protocol.scope: This replays one saved seed1879 trajectory on the current deterministic CUDA software/hardware stack. An endpoint mismatch blocks mechanistic interpretation and may indicate environment drift or replay nondeterminism.
protocol.stop_rule: Report the fixed qualification and trajectory classification; do not relax exactness, insert post-hoc milestones, or interpret intermediate checkpoints after a replay mismatch.

diagnosis.registered_stop_boundary: Report the fixed dense trajectory; do not insert milestones or change thresholds after observing formation.
